title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Jesse Eisenberg, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti, and Halle Bailey on The Debut
excerpt_original: The director and cast join to discuss their darkly funny and moving portrait of a community theater troupe

blocks.text: On this week’s episode, writer-director Jesse Eisenberg and actors Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti, and Halle Bailey join to discuss their upcoming film, The Debut. Eisenberg’s third feature, following 2024’s A Real Pain, The Debut stars Moore as a mousey New Jersey housewife whose life takes a wild turn when she decides to audition for a play at her local community theater. Under the tutelage of the intimidating director, played by Giamatti, Moore’s character is forced to reach for parts of herself that have long been repressed—leading to dark, unpredictably funny, and deeply moving results.

Film Comment Editor Devika Girish sat down with Eisenberg and the cast in front of a live audience at Alice Tully Hall after the film screened at the New York Film Festival last month. The Debut opens in limited release on December 11.
